title: Settings
description: Limits, look and language. Changes save on this computer.

account.title: Account & limits
account.subtitle: Written to the skills' config. Every ticket is sized and risk-checked against these.
account.loadFailed: Couldn't load your current settings. Showing defaults.

hints.accountSize: Cash you trade with. USD only in v1.
hints.maxLossPerTrade: The most you'll lose if the stop is hit. Position size is worked out from this.
hints.maxDailyLoss: New entries are blocked once today's total risk would go over this.
hints.maxTradesPerDay: New entries are blocked after this many trades.
hints.minRewardRisk: Target distance divided by stop distance. 1.5 means the target is 1.5× the stop.
hints.cashBuffer: Share of the account that is never used for positions.
hints.pdtGuard: Warns before a fourth day trade in five days on accounts under $25,000.

window.title: Entry window (New York time)
window.hint: Entries are only allowed inside the window. Every open trade should be closed by the flat-by time.

errors.aboveDaily: Can't be higher than the daily loss limit
errors.aboveAccount: Can't be higher than the account size
errors.integer: Enter a whole number, 1 or more
errors.window: Must be later than the previous time

data.title: Data & SEC
data.description: Data sources, delay and your SEC EDGAR identity.

ai.title: AI (optional)
ai.description: Plain-language summaries with your own Claude API key. Off by default; every tool works without it.

appearance.presetsHint: Seven built-in presets, including a light theme. Select one to apply it.
appearance.presetHint: Built-in themes are read-only. Changing a colour creates your own copy.
appearance.customHint: Your theme. Changes apply instantly and are saved on this computer.
appearance.previewHint: Ticket levels always use the Text colour. Profit and Loss only colour the small markers.
appearance.resetDone: Colours reset to the original preset
appearance.name: Name
appearance.nameHint: Give your theme a short name.
appearance.deleteHint: This theme will be removed from this computer. Export it first if you want to keep a copy.

contrast.title: Contrast check (WCAG AA)
contrast.ok: All colour pairs meet WCAG AA contrast.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: The whole interface switches instantly.
language.formatsHint: Numbers and dates follow the language you choose.
language.marketTimeNote: Market times are always shown in New York time (ET), wherever you are.

about.title: About Levelset
about.notAdvice: Not financial advice. Most day traders lose money.
about.thirdPartyHint: Levelset runs the day-trader-skill pack, used under the MIT License.
